title: Wrongly Indicted Man Seeks Inquiry of Official Conduct in Reflecting Pool Case
summary: Lawyers for the former Olympian David Hearn accused prosecutors of ignoring their own evidence to indict him and then providing “blatantly false” information about what they knew when.
body_markdown: Lawyers for the former Olympian David Hearn accused prosecutors of ignoring their own evidence to indict him and then providing “blatantly false” information about what they knew when.
